wizard-spider.reason: The CTID Wizard Spider Operations Flow explicitly groups source steps into three named phases. The YAML preserves step numbers but not phase objects, so this reviewed mapping creates bounded phase Chains without changing procedure order.

phase_chains.name: Phase 1 - Emotet Initial Access and Collection
phase_chains.description: Wizard Spider uses Emotet for initial access, persistence, host discovery, Outlook collection, and movement toward the next host.
phase_chains.objective: Validate detection and response across the documented Emotet portion of the Wizard Spider scenario.

phase_chains.name: Phase 2 - TrickBot Discovery and Domain Access
phase_chains.description: Wizard Spider uses TrickBot for lateral movement, extensive discovery, Kerberoasting, domain controller access, persistence, and domain mapping.
phase_chains.objective: Validate cross-stage detection and response across the documented TrickBot portion of the Wizard Spider scenario.

phase_chains.name: Phase 3 - Recovery Inhibition and Ryuk Impact
phase_chains.description: Wizard Spider inhibits recovery by stopping backup services and deleting recovery material before the documented Ryuk ransomware impact stage.
phase_chains.objective: Validate high-consequence controls and response for recovery inhibition and ransomware impact in an authorized lab.
